# The four-finger interdigitated coupler as one part (MIDC): four strips, the ports on the outer two. Its jumpers are
# bond wires, stood in for here by inductors with no artwork, so the layout has none and LVS names each as unmatched;
# on a board they are a wire part, not copper in the .clay.
